verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a local, open-source command-line package manager that installs software onto the user's own machine. It does not host user data, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. The only related evidence is the ability to turn off anonymous aggregate analytics, which is a different control and does not make the residency axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
